description: Synthetic notes for memory recall: 8 target notes among 32 unrelated ones, and 10 questions. The first 8 questions avoid their note's own words, so only meaning can find them; the last 2 are one-word keyword questions. Every note is invented; none comes from a real person's data. Scored by memory_index::tests::fused_recall_on_the_synthetic_fixture_meets_the_documented_floor.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Travel
notes.text: Flights to Lisbon on 12 March, TAP 1357 leaving at 07:40. Hotel Alfama Patio for four nights, check-in after 3pm. Train out to Sintra on the Saturday, back on Sunday evening.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Groceries
notes.text: Oat milk, a dozen eggs, spinach, two lemons, basmati rice, coffee beans, washing-up liquid and bin bags.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Quotes
notes.text: Three contractors for the bathroom: Silva and Sons 4,200 euros including tiling, BuildRight 3,850 without tiles, Costa Renovations 4,600 with a two-year guarantee. Ask BuildRight what tiling adds.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Workshop
notes.text: Room 4B booked 9:30 to 16:00 on Thursday. Projector and two flipcharts, lunch for 14 from the canteen, name badges, slides emailed to attendees the day before.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Project next step
notes.text: Once legal signs off the data agreement, start the pilot with the Porto clinic and put the kickoff in the diary for the week after.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Handoff
notes.text: Marta covers the billing migration while I am on leave. Open tickets live on the Migration board, the weekly sync moves to Tuesdays, and the vendor contact is Paulo.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Launch checklist
notes.text: Before release: final QA pass, update the app store screenshots, write the release notes, confirm the support rota, flip the feature flag at 10am.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Meeting follow-up
notes.text: From Monday's catch-up with the design agency: Ana sends revised mockups by Wednesday, I review the copy, Sam books the user tests.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Banana bread
notes.text: Three overripe bananas, 250g flour, 100g butter, two eggs, a teaspoon of baking soda. Bake at 175 for an hour and add walnuts on top.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Books to read
notes.text: The Overstory, Piranesi, A Gentleman in Moscow, and the new Ishiguro when it comes out in paperback.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Car service
notes.text: Oil change due at 45,000 km. Front tyres are worn, ask the garage about the rattle from the back left wheel.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Gift ideas
notes.text: Mum likes gardening gloves and lavender soap. Dad wants a good pocket knife. Leo is into dinosaurs and puzzles.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Running plan
notes.text: Week 3: easy 5k Tuesday, intervals Thursday, long run of 12k on Sunday. Stretch after every session.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Wi-Fi at the cabin
notes.text: Router is behind the bookshelf. If it drops, unplug it for thirty seconds. The neighbour's network is the backup.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Plant care
notes.text: Water the fern twice a week, the cactus once a month. The fiddle leaf fig wants bright indirect light and no draughts.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Podcast episodes
notes.text: Episode on sleep science, the one about the history of salt, and the interview with the deep sea diver.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Film night
notes.text: Spirited Away, Paddington 2, The Grand Budapest Hotel. Popcorn and the big blanket from the cupboard.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Dentist
notes.text: Check-up on the 3rd at 14:20 with Dr Ferreira. Mention the sensitive tooth on the upper right.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Garden
notes.text: Plant the tulip bulbs before the first frost. Prune the roses in late winter and move the herbs to the sunny side.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Recipes to try
notes.text: Shakshuka with feta, Thai green curry with tofu, lemon risotto, and the miso aubergine from the cookbook.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Bike repair
notes.text: Rear brake pads are squeaking. Replace the chain, true the front wheel and pump the tyres to 80 psi.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Spanish practice
notes.text: Irregular verbs in the preterite: tener, poder, hacer. Practise ordering in a restaurant and asking for directions.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Bird sightings
notes.text: Saw a kingfisher by the river on Sunday morning, two herons and a flock of goldfinches in the park.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Home insurance
notes.text: Policy renews in June. Compare the excess and whether accidental damage to the laptop is covered.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Guitar
notes.text: Learn the intro to Blackbird, practise barre chords for ten minutes a day, restring before the open mic.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Cleaning rota
notes.text: Kitchen on Mondays, bathroom Wednesdays, hoover the stairs at the weekend, and descale the kettle monthly.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Birthday party
notes.text: Leo turns six on the 20th. Soft play centre booked for 2pm, ten kids, dinosaur cake ordered from the bakery.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Tax
notes.text: Gather the receipts for home office costs and the charity donations, and file the return before the end of January.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Coffee beans
notes.text: The Ethiopian natural tasted of blueberries. The Colombian washed was too bright. Grind finer for the moka pot.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Photography
notes.text: Golden hour shots at the harbour, try a slower shutter for the waterfall, and back up the SD card to the drive.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Neighbours
notes.text: The Okafors at number 12 water our plants when we are away. Their cat is called Biscuit and is not allowed treats.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Kitchen ideas
notes.text: Open shelving above the sink, warmer bulbs under the cabinets, and a magnetic strip for the knives.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Board games
notes.text: Wingspan for four players, Codenames for big groups, and Patchwork when it is just the two of us.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Sleep
notes.text: No screens after 10pm, keep the bedroom cool, and try the breathing exercise if I wake up at 4am.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Volunteering
notes.text: Food bank shift every second Saturday, 9 to 12. Bring the trolley and wear closed shoes.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Laptop setup
notes.text: Install the editor, set up the terminal theme, turn on FileVault and add the printer on the second floor.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Pottery class
notes.text: Wednesday evenings at the studio. Wedge the clay properly, keep the walls even, glaze firing in two weeks.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Dog sitting
notes.text: Bolt eats twice a day, one scoop each. Walk him before 8am and after 6pm, and keep him away from the geese.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Allotment
notes.text: Courgettes are taking over. Net the strawberries against the pigeons and order manure for the spring.

notes.title: BuntiniQA-Quiz night
notes.text: Team name is The Quizzard of Oz. Brush up on capital cities, 90s pop and the periodic table.
